english.title: Conspire to produce a controlled drug of class C - other
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) conspired together with

(A)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..)]_
(B)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSONS..)]_
(C)_[another person]_
(D)_[other persons]_

to produce

(E)_[**(..SPECIFY QUANTITY..)]_
(F)_[a quantity]_

of **(..SPECIFY THE DRUG..), a controlled drug of class C in contravention of section 4(1) of the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1) of the Criminal Law Act 1977.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
conspired with another / others
to produce a controlled drug
of class C - other

investigatoraction.description: Submit a form Crimsec 38 where drugs are seized

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) Only use this offence wording document for a class C drug which does not have a specific CJS Code and wording.
